_about: MM3D product facts (owner decision 2026-11-08, BRANDING answer 1): the installed game executable takes the product name. The build output stays TriAevum.exe (runtime/TriAevum.exe in the package); the MM3D Forge (feature title-mm3d) renames it at install (forge-catalog platform.rs WINDOWS_PRODUCT_EXECUTABLE). Guard words: Moonfall Curse, Majora's Mask 3D. Linux (owner decision 2026-11-08, Linux names): linux_executable is the installed game binary name; the Linux package keeps the build output TriAevum at its root and Forge renames it at install (forge-catalog platform.rs LINUX_PRODUCT_EXECUTABLE). pipeline_cache_namespace names the title's renderer pipeline cache files (nri_pipeline_cache.mm3d.bin): the runtime's title session (titles/mm3d/shaders/mm3d_shader_preparation.h) and the Forge's device pipeline preparation (forge-catalog title.rs) use this one value; the empty namespace is the original file names.
